entry.name: uzi
entry.description: Outputs a specified number of bang messages quickly. uzi is designed for rapid-fire output of a large number of bang messages.

arguments.name: initial
arguments.description: Sets an initial number ofmessages to be sent out in response to ain the left inlet. If no argument is present,is initially set to send out one.

arguments.name: base
arguments.description: An optional second argument sets the base value for the right outlet count. The base value defaults to 1 when no second argument is given.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Begins sending outmessages as fast as possible, one after another. The number ofmessages to send is determined by the last number received in either inlet.

messages.name: in1
messages.digest: Set the number of bangs with no output
messages.description: In right inlet: Sets the number ofmessages to send, without causing output.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Set the number of bangs, cause output
messages.description: In left inlet: Sets the number ofmessages to send, then begins sending them out as fast as possible, one after another.

messages.name: offset
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a number of bangs will set the object to output a count of bangs which is offset by the given number (the number is subtracted from the previously assigned number of bangs to equal the new total number of bangs).

messages.name: pause
messages.description: In left inlet: Causesto stop in the midst of sending its output. (Sincesends its output as fast as possible, this message must be triggered in some way by the output ofitself.)keeps track of how manymessages it has sent, and if it receives themessage before sending out all itsmessages, it can then be caused to send out the rest of itsmessages with aormessage.

messages.name: resume
messages.description: In left inlet: Ifhas been stopped by amessage in the midst of sending its output,causes it to send out the rest of its output.
